title: Workflow project profile
description: A project's facts for the workflow commands: commands, gates, tiers, test DBs, limits. Path: <project>/.claude/workflow-profile.json. Uses only the draft-07 keywords type, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, enum, minimum, minLength, minItems, maxItems and pattern, so a dependency-free checker can validate it. Cross-field rules (an agent gate needs verifier, other gates need cmd; no tier runs commands.test_full) are checked by profile-check.mjs. Protocol: ~/.claude/commands/_shared-project-profile.md.

docs.description: Where the project's own rules live, as path#anchor. Skills reference these by section and never copy them.

release_branch.description: The release branch the integration base must contain; /implement-batch checks it before each wave of launches.

shell_prefix.description: Prepended to every command and gate a skill runs.

test_task.description: One targeted run per task. Placeholder {files}.

test_full.description: The one full run per cut.

cleanup_list.description: Read-only: lists what a batch leaves behind (worktrees, branches, test DBs, ports). Run once at batch close.

gates.description: The gate registry: gate name -> how to run it. Tiers name gates from here. A "notes" string is allowed and is not a gate.

cmd.description: The command. Required for every kind but agent; for an agent gate, an optional read-only helper whose output the agent receives.

verifier.description: kind agent only, and required there: the agent type that judges the gate. It passes only when that agent returns PASS.

asks.description: kind agent only: the one-line task the agent is given.

smoke.description: Safe to run in the scaffold's smoke run.

tiers.description: When each gate runs. Every entry names a gate in the registry.

invariant_suites.description: Test paths that are never quarantined and run first at cut end.

heavy_jobs.description: Slot name -> how many may run at once, and where the locks live. A "notes" string is allowed and is not a job.

lock_dir.description: Where the slot locks live. Default ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/workflow-slots/<job>; profile-check warns when it is unset.

self_locking.description: The job takes its own lock: skills never wrap it in slot.sh. The watchdog still counts its holders in lock_dir.

merge.description: How a lane merge renumbers and checks migrations (merge-lane.mjs).

renumber.description: Puts the lane's colliding migrations after the integration head's. Placeholder {base}: the integration head before the merge.

check.description: Verifies the migration journal after the merge.

url.description: Template of the {url} placeholder. Placeholders {host}, {port}, {name}; {host} and {name} are required. Default postgresql://{host}:{port}/{name}. A user and password may be written in it only for a local test database.

names.description: Port names a lane gets when its lane-map entry has no "ports". Default ["api"].

step.description: Distance between two lanes' base ports. Default 1.

offsets.description: Port name -> offset from the lane's base port, e.g. {"web": 2000}. A name without one takes the next free offset 0, 1, 2…

known_reds.description: File listing reds that predate the cut. Every run subtracts it: only a red missing from it is triaged; a listed file now green is reported for removal.

tests.description: Machine-wide heavy-job lock and the merge delta selection (_shared-test-selection.md). Never smoke-run.

heavy_lock.description: Wraps a heavy job (full run, rehearsal, sharded run, broad selection) in the one-per-machine lock. Placeholders {owner} (a label peers see) and {cmd} (the job).

heavy_lock_token.description: The environment variable a held lock exports; a heavy_lock call that carries it joins the hold instead of waiting (a release verification's pair).

merge_delta.description: The test run at a merge: the delta between the two sides. Placeholders {ours} (the target head before the merge) and {theirs} (the merged-in head).

release.description: The hotfix path and the release (_shared-test-selection.md, Hotfix and release). Never smoke-run; release.deploy needs the owner's approval of that deploy (_shared-commit-protocol.md).

hotfix_start.description: Creates a hotfix worktree and branch off docs.release_branch. Placeholder {hotfix} (its name).

hotfix_finish.description: Merges the hotfix into the release branch ({release_branch}); the back-merge into the integration branch follows the deploy. Placeholder {hotfix}.

package.description: Builds the deploy bundle without deploying; started while the wide run runs. Placeholder {bundle} (the output path).

deploy.description: Deploys a packaged bundle at the next safe window. Placeholders {bundle}, {description} (carries the owner's approval words).

overrides.description: Role -> model, where a cheaper model is allowed.

provenance.description: One row per change, newest last.
